pr_title: Validate Object pointers on binder method calls
pr_body:
Fixes #80339

Not sure if it's the right fix, probably not.
Passing a freed object now results in a familiar error:
```
Invalid type in function 'add_child' in base 'Node2D (GodotCrasher.gd)'. The Object-derived class of argument 1 (previously freed) is not a subclass of the expected argument class.
```
pr_comments:
Just tested this; This PR fixes #86602  (and possibly https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/86427 as well). 

Pursuant to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/57205#pullrequestreview-1798728003, recommend changing the line mentioned above.
This PR seems to break `is_instance_valid()` so it's likely not proper fix after all.

I'm unable to fix it for some reason. Force pushes don't appear. In fact, no push appears in the history, so it's like it broke for no reason 🤔 (I did update the branch though, few days ago. The checks were processing today, so I doubt they were started by that push)

issue_context.title: Crash when closing scenes after interacting with the animation player
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

Current master (13a0d6e9b253654f5cc2a44f3d0b3cae10440443)

### System information

MacOS - Godot v4.3-13a0d6e9

### Issue description

Getting crashes with EA_BAD_ACCESS when closing scenes after interacting with the animation player under certain conditions.
The scenario is: opening the scene, interacting with the animation player, highlighting something else, and then closing it.
It can crash with both non-inherited and inherited scenes, but is more easily reproduced with inherited scenes from newly-imported scenes (i.e. glb, dae, etc.)


I thought it might have to do with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/57205#pullrequestreview-1798728003, but changing that line to check for `!obj` first doesn't help.

Backtrace:

### Steps to reproduce

Double click on AnimatedMorphCube.glb, then click "Reimport".
Create a new inherited scene from AnimatedMorphCube.glb
In the Scene tab, Click on `Animation Player`
Then, click on `AnimationMorphCube`
Then, close the scene tab. It should crash with a back trace.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[another_test_project.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/13792066/another_test_project.zip)

review_comments: This will only catch if the variant is an object, and it was freed, not if it's `null` to start with, or not an object
I think `can_convert_strict()` already ensures that the Variant is Object.

change the line just below this to 
```
return !obj || Object::cast_to<TStripped>(p_variant);
```
